final_message: Fixed the groupBy result-cache reader: it never advanced the post-aggregate destination index, so later metrics overwrote the first slot and left others null. The reader now uses an incrementing, bounded index to restore each metric to its correct position. Added regression coverage for zero, one, and multiple post-aggregates, with and without timestamps.
